note: #979, correction cycle 1: a refused rule set says what it leaves (the refused version is not written; a version written earlier under the same name stays attached and enforced), a host Verify found below the floor writes no rule set, a stateless refusal on an OVN host Verify narrowed names the host's reason rather than the mode in use, and incus-release.sh comments once per release. One mutation per question. Correction cycle 2 adds: isolation refused below the floor and Isolation withdrawn with the firewall; the way out of each refusal said apart; the role's guard held to doctor's table. NOT HERE: the Ansible guard on bookworm and jammy (exercised by ansible-playbook --check, not by a Go test).
